artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent brow, sharp nose, a mustache, and chin hair. His curly hair is short. He is wearing an ornate jacket with decorative detailing and a high ruffled collar. There are no visible accessories. The background includes an oval frame with text around the perimeter and scribbled lines indicating a plain or textured backdrop. The portrait seems to be an engraved print, with a name or title and the year "1608" inscribed at the bottom.

He is dressed in a high-collared garment with intricate patterns and a cloak secured with a decorative brooch at his shoulder. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscriptions surrounding the portrait. The area outside the oval frame is shaded with horizontal lines for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange

The man is dressed in elaborate historical clothing, wearing a dark robe with a high pleated collar and decorative embroidery. artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange

artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, centered within an oval frame. He is slightly turned to his right, with his head facing forward. The man has a middle-aged face with a short beard and mustache. His hair is short and neatly styled. He is dressed in period clothing with a high ruffled collar. The man is surrounded by scrollwork and decorative medallions. At the top of the frame, a cherub is blowing a horn-like structure. The background is filled with scrolling patterns and text.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange on Horseback
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man riding a horse. The man is upright in the saddle, with his head turned to the side. He appears to be wearing armor, a sash, and holding a baton. The horse is rearing on its hind legs and is adorned with a decorative bridle and saddle. In the background, there is a battle scene with an army formation and a castle or fortification. The sky is etched with sweeping lines.

artworks.title: Thomas Maurois

They have a mustache, beard, short hair, and wear a dark, buttoned garment with a white ruffled collar. The portrait is framed in an oval design with surrounding text, against a lined background. The lower section contains additional text.

artworks.title: Thomas Maurois
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body, with his right hand resting on his chest. He is positioned facing slightly to the right of the viewer, with a solemn expression on his face. The man has short hair, combed back, and a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. He is wearing a large ruffled collar and a dark garment that appears to be buttoned down the front. The background is plain and features a decorative oval border with Latin text surrounding the figure. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. Below the oval border, there is additional Latin text framed within a rectangle.

artworks.title: Maximilian I, Son of Emperor Frederick III
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing slightly to the right with his head turned to the left. He has a long, pointed nose, a medium length beard, wears a hat with draped fabric, and his hair flows down to his shoulders. He is dressed in elaborate robes with intricate patterns, adorned with a lined collar and edges, and wears a belt around his waist. The man is holding his left hand on his hip while his right hand points downward. A sword with an ornate handle lies near his feet. The background includes an arched architectural structure with detailed carvings, rolling hills, and a town or city in the distance under a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian I

He has sharp features and medium-length wavy hair under an intricate hat. He wears elaborate robes with ornate patterns and decorations, suggesting high status or royalty. His attire includes a richly adorned cloak, embroidered with a large, decorative collar. He holds a scepter or staff in his right hand, with the left hand resting on the edge of his cloak. The background features architectural elements like columns and an archway, framing the figure against a mountainous landscape.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici (?)
artworks.description: This image is a bust portrait of a person, displaying their upper body from the chest upwards. The person is positioned facing slightly to their left, with their gaze directed towards the viewer. The individual has a solemn facial expression with elongated features. The person's hair is styled in elaborate roll and braided patterns. They are wearing a high, pleated ruff collar and a detailed garment with button decorations, piping, and shoulder embellishments. A small cross pendant hangs around their neck. The background is an oval-shaped shaded pattern, framing the subject. There is a lightly drawn sketch and inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France
artworks.description: The engraving depicts the upper body of a woman seated and facing slightly to her right. She has distinct facial features, short wavy hair styled back with a decorative headpiece adorned with pearls and jewels. She wears an intricate dress with fur trimming, holds an ornate fan in her right hand, and wears a pearl necklace and bracelet. In the background, there is a textured surface bordered by an oval frame with a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right, with a direct, forward-facing look. Their facial features include prominent eyes, a long nose, and a tight-lipped expression. The person's hair is curled and short, adorned with a cap that is part of an elaborate headdress. They are wearing a high-collared garment with a decorative ruff, and the clothing appears textured and ornate, with puffed sleeves. Around their neck is a large, ruffled collar. The background features a finely detailed design and text encircling the portrait within an oval frame, with additional text beneath the image on what looks like a paper surface.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France

She wears a dress with an elaborate ruffled collar, long sleeves, and a plain fabric bonnet. In the background, there are fluted columns and a landscape with a castle and hilly terrain. The scene is framed by an ornate border with detailed engravings.
